DROP TABLE reservation_details;

SET LINESIZE 200;
SET PAGESIZE 200;
SET DEFINE OFF;

COLUMN reserveID      FORMAT A8;
COLUMN copyID         FORMAT A8;
COLUMN reserveStatus  FORMAT A15;

CREATE TABLE Reservation_Details (
    reserveID      VARCHAR2(7) NOT NULL,
    copyID         VARCHAR2(7) NOT NULL,
    reserveStatus  VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (reserveID, copyID),
    FOREIGN KEY (reserveID) REFERENCES Reservation(reserveID),
    FOREIGN KEY (copyID) REFERENCES Book_Copy(copyID)
);
